evidence_text: Official Environment Agency persistent WCS 2.0.1 endpoint for LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model Last Return DSM 1m. The associated official dataset is a 1 m raster DSM covering approximately 99% of England, uses EPSG:27700, is Open Government Licence data with no public access constraints, and includes surface objects such as buildings and vegetation together with terrain. This producer records the service evidence only; parcel spatial join, raster sampling/materialization and height-difference calculation remain local OpenCode responsibilities.
